title: Customers charged twice for a single order
alert: Support escalation: 23 tickets in 40 minutes reporting duplicate card charges for one order. Finance reconciliation job flagged 61 orders with more than one captured charge since 18:05 UTC. No error-rate alert fired.

updates.text: Duplicate charges are still happening: 9 more orders were double-charged in the last 5 minutes. Stop the bleeding first, then finish the root cause.
